questions.text: Choose the most appropriate HTML tag in the following to create a numbered list
questions.solution:
The HTML ol tag creates an ordered (numbered) list; ul creates a bulleted list and dl a definition list.

Answer: ol

questions.text: Which of the following is TRUE only of XML but NOT HTML?
questions.solution:
Both XML and HTML come from SGML. HTML has a fixed set of tags; XML lets you define your own tags.

Answer: It allows user defined tags

questions.text: To declare the version of XML, the correct syntax is
questions.solution:
The XML declaration is written as [latex]\lt[/latex]?xml version="1.0"?[latex]\gt[/latex], with "?" right after "[latex]\lt[/latex]". Among the options, option 3 (with double quotes) is the one marked in the key.

Answer: Option 3

questions.text: The correct syntax to write "Hi there" in Javascript is
questions.solution:
Among the given choices, response.write("Hi There") writes output (used in server-side JScript/ASP). In browser JavaScript the usual call is document.write.

The other options are not valid JavaScript methods.

Answer: response.write ("Hi There")
